title: Measuring Context-Word Biases in Lexical Semantic Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on inputs where the target word is masked (providing only the context) and calculating the ratio of this performance compared to the full input, adjusted for a random label baseline.

Evaluating model performance on inputs consisting solely of the isolated target word (removing the surrounding context) and calculating the ratio of this performance compared to the full input, adjusted for a random label baseline.
